**Issue #4093 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #4093: Patch: the `tools fuzz` and `ai slow` test groups move to the daily run
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

## Owner decision: relaxed CI rules for this issue (2026-11-16)

**This is a deliberate cut of per-pull-request coverage, decided by the repository's owners. Do not decline it, stall on it, ask for a decision about it, or mark it `human required` on the grounds below.** JackiOh has zero non-developer users and merges about 46 pull requests a day (323 in the week to 2026-11-16), each running CI three times. CI time is worth more to us right now than catching a fuzz or AI-game regression a few hours sooner.

For this issue, and only this issue, these standing rules are **explicitly waived**:

- **CLAUDE.md, CI:** "A test moves there (`#[ignore = "daily: <why>"]`) only when a cheaper test keeps its rule per pull request, which its `daily:` reason names." **Waived.** The tests this issue moves need **no** cheaper per-PR stand-in, and you must not write one to justify the move. Their reason names this issue instead, exactly as:
  `#[ignore = "daily: off per-PR CI by owner decision (#4093), no per-PR stand-in"]`
  (The `acceptance.rs` lint `daily_every_ignored_test_says_it_runs_daily` only checks the `daily: ` prefix, so this passes.)
- **`ci.yml`'s header, `ci-duration.yml`, `scripts/ci-shards.toml`'s header:** a slow group "is split further, never folded back". **Waived.** Cutting, not splitting, is the intended fix.
- **Rule 6's "covering base and Radiant behavior"** and similar coverage wording: not at issue here. These are integration sweeps, not a card's own tests. Leave card tests alone.

Still in force: nothing is deleted or disabled. Every test you move keeps running each day in `super.yml`'s `daily tests` job (`cargo test --workspace --tests … -- --ignored`, which includes the `jackioh` binary's unit tests). `cargo jackioh spec check` still passes: a ruling's proving test may be ignored for a daily reason. CLAUDE.md rule 12 still applies.

## Why

Once #4092 takes e2e smoke off the slowest chain, these two groups become the longest Rust jobs in every pull-request and merge-queue run (runs 43976253406 and 43972617911, 2026-11-16):

| group (`.github/ci/rust-test.toml`) | command | `cargo test` step |
|---|---|---|
| `rust (test ai slow)` | `-p jackioh-ai --test ai_slow` (`match_`, `shadow_ban`, `tutorial_tier`, `lethal`, `duos_gate`) | 6.6–6.7 min |
| `rust (test tools fuzz)` | `-p jackioh-tools --bin jackioh -- fuzz:: positions:: --skip duos_fuzz::` | 4.3–6.2 min |

Per-PR fuzzing is already covered by `rust (checks, fuzz 200)`, which runs 200 seeds on the release build in about 0.5 min. The debug-build `fuzz::` tests mostly repeat it slowly.

## What to do

1. Time each test in both groups locally (for example, run each module or test by name and time it).
2. Mark every test that takes more than about 10 seconds with the `daily:` reason above. Keep the fast ones per-PR.
3. Target: each group's `cargo test` step under about 2 minutes, compile included. An empty group (every test ignored) is acceptable.
4. Don't edit `.github/ci/rust-test.toml` (you can't). If a group ends up empty or near-empty, say so in the pull request body so a person can delete or merge it.
5. If `rust (test tools duos, selfplay)` (3.1–3.5 min) has tests over about 10 seconds, the same treatment applies to them.
6. Update `crates/ai/tests/ai_slow.rs`'s header and any README that says these run per pull request.

## Acceptance

- `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai_slow` and `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --bin jackioh -- fuzz:: positions:: --skip duos_fuzz::` each finish in about 2 minutes or less on a CI runner. The pull request body gives the before and after times from its own CI run.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai_slow -- --ignored` and the matching `--ignored` run for the tools binary pass locally, so the daily run stays green.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --test acceptance daily` and `cargo jackioh spec check` pass.

## Plan

_Written by `claude-8` (claude, `sonnet`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43984436923)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

The `ai slow` and `tools fuzz` groups, and the two over-10-second tests in `tools duos, selfplay`, stop running per pull request. Every test the builder marks `#[ignore = "daily: off per-PR CI by owner decision (#4093), no per-PR stand-in"]` still runs each day in `super.yml`'s `--ignored` run. No test is deleted, and no stand-in is written. Docs that say these tests run per pull request are updated. The PR body reports the groups' before and after times and says if a group ends up empty or near-empty.

The owner's waiver in the issue overrides the CLAUDE.md "cheaper test keeps its rule" condition for this issue only. Don't write a stand-in test.

## Files to touch

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/shadow_ban.rs` | Add the ignore line to 5 tests |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/lethal.rs` | Add the ignore line to 2 tests |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/match_.rs` | Add the ignore line to 1 test |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai_slow.rs` | Rewrite the header: it no longer runs per PR |
| `crates/ai/README.md` | Commands block, lines ~631–633 |
| `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs` | Add the ignore line to 10 tests |
| `crates/tools/src/positions.rs` | Add the ignore line to 2 tests |
| `crates/tools/src/duos_fuzz.rs` | Add the ignore line to 1 test |
| `crates/tools/src/selfplay.rs` | Add the ignore line to 1 test |
| `crates/tools/fuzz-corpus/README.md` | "Running it" paragraph, "the `rust` check does" |

Do not touch `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/` or `.claude/`. Also leave `scripts/ci-scope.sh` alone: the groups still compile and run their fast tests. No card scripts, no spec notes and no new rulings are needed. `cargo jackioh spec check` accepts a `daily:` ignore on a ruling's proving test (`ignored_but_not_daily` in `crates/tools/src/spec.rs` only rejects non-`daily:` reasons), so the `r…` tests below stay cited as they are.

## Steps

The ignore line is exactly this, on its own line directly under the test's `#[test]`, with the same indentation:

`#[ignore = "daily: off per-PR CI by owner decision (#4093), no per-PR stand-in"]`

It must start with `#[ignore = "daily: ` because `acceptance.rs`'s lint `daily_every_ignored_test_says_it_runs_daily` scans for that prefix. Leave the existing ignored tests alone. Use `Grep` for `fn <name>` to find each test, since line numbers move as you insert.

The ignore set was picked by timing each test alone with `--test-threads=1`: mark every test that takes about 8 s or more on its own. Under-threshold tests stay per PR. Times are debug builds on a 4-core box.

1. **`crates/ai/tests/ai/shadow_ban.rs`**: add the line under `#[test]` of:
   - `r186_giga_glowy_jelly_bean_6_mana_is_judged_at_hards_seven_crystals` (122 s)
   - `b25_sweep_card_on_tempo_timmy_over_2_seeds_plays_2_games_and_flags_no_error` (26 s)
   - `r977000_a_decision_the_clock_found_slow_and_the_retimer_found_fast_is_a_raw_timeout_not_a_timeout` (24 s)
   - `r977000_a_decision_slow_by_the_clock_and_by_the_retimer_is_a_timeout` (24 s)
   - `r977000_without_a_retimer_every_decision_the_clock_found_slow_is_a_timeout` (23 s)

2. **`crates/ai/tests/ai/lethal.rs`**: add the line to `ready_gap_counts_exactly_the_units_legal_actions_lists_an_attack_for_from_either_seat` (13.6 s) and `two_one_step_children_with_one_signature_score_the_same_and_offer_the_same_moves` (8.3 s).

3. **`crates/ai/tests/ai/match_.rs`**: add the line to `b26_an_ai_vs_greedy_gate_game_is_deterministic_and_folds_to_its_hash_with_nothing_rejected` (9.9 s).

4. **`crates/ai/tests/ai_slow.rs`**: rewrite the `//!` header, keeping the list of modules and the `#[path]` paragraph.
   - It must say the binary is no longer CI's per-PR coverage: its slow tests carry `#[ignore = "daily: off per-PR CI by owner decision (#4093), no per-PR stand-in"]` and run in `super.yml`'s daily tests via `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai_slow -- --ignored`.
   - It must say the fast tests in these modules still run per PR as `rust (test ai slow)`.
   - It must say that if the group is ever empty or merged away, nothing else changes.

5. **`crates/ai/README.md`**, the Commands block:
   - The `--test ai_slow` line gets a comment: "the fast tests per PR (`rust (test ai slow)`); the many-game and sweep tests are `#[ignore = "daily: …"]` (#4093), run by `-- --ignored`".
   - Change the first line's "but the daily ones" so `ai_slow.rs` no longer reads as fully run per PR.

6. **`crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs`**: add the line to each test below. All are inside nested `mod`s under `mod tests`, so they are indented 8 spaces like the existing `#[ignore]` near `the_days_extra_seeds_keep_every_pool_card_s_deals_as_the_pool_grows`. Isolated times:
   - `a_run_start_game_plays_monitor_clean_and_folds_back_to_its_live_hash` (28.9 s)
   - `plays_the_seeded_games_to_a_result_and_replays_each_to_the_same_hash_short_wave` (24.7 s)
   - `r180_seeds_with_one_seat_on_medium_or_hard_no_throw_a_real_ending_and_a_replay_that_matches` (20.6 s)
   - `the_checked_in_corpus_lints_clean_and_every_record_replays` (15.8 s)
   - `the_gate_s_channel_games_log_its_actions_and_fold_back_from_a_concede_and_an_accepted_draw` (14.5 s)
   - `a_run_seed_played_alone_is_counted_as_run_in_the_summary_and_the_json` (13.7 s)
   - `a_game_from_each_start_plays_monitor_clean_and_folds_back_to_its_live_hash` (10.6 s)
   - `the_coverage_is_the_same_on_one_thread_and_on_four` (9.4 s)
   - `a_planted_portal_to_the_past_is_cast_from_a_manufactured_last_board_and_the_game_folds_back` (9.3 s)
   - `a_planted_listener_s_opponent_emotes_through_the_channel_and_the_game_folds_back` (9.1 s). Two tests share the same name in `fuzz_endings_channel` and `fuzz_starting_states` only in the sense of similar prefixes, so Grep each full `fn` name and confirm it is the one you want.

7. **`crates/tools/src/positions.rs`**: add the line to `r1006006_reply_rows_are_the_search_s_simulated_replies_one_per_turn_end` (19.9 s) and `r1006003_a_game_that_does_not_replay_has_no_result_or_an_unknown_catalog_is_dropped` (13.4 s).

8. **`crates/tools/src/duos_fuzz.rs`**: add the line to `a_duos_channel_game_concedes_as_a_team_and_one_reaches_the_ceiling_and_each_folds_back` (11.3 s).

9. **`crates/tools/src/selfplay.rs`**: add the line to `r1006001_the_same_base_and_count_give_byte_identical_lines_on_one_or_four_threads` (32.9 s).

10. **`crates/tools/fuzz-corpus/README.md`**, "Running it": replace "The tools' `cargo test` runs the same, so the `rust` check does." Say instead that `the_checked_in_corpus_lints_clean_and_every_record_replays` is `#[ignore = "daily: …"]` (#4093) and runs in the daily tests, so a pull request replays the corpus only through `cargo jackioh fuzz --regress`. Check first whether CI actually runs `--regress`: `grep -rn -- "--regress" .github/workflows` returned nothing when I looked. If nothing runs it, write "a pull request does not replay the corpus; the daily run does".

11. Run the commands below and fill in the before and after numbers for the PR body.

## Tests

Add no new tests. This is an ignore-only change, and the tests are the existing ones. Run, in this order:

- `cargo fmt --check`
- `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai_slow`: expect only fast tests, about 50 s of tests on 4 threads. Before: 103 passed in 175 s, with `giga` alone taking 122 s.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai_slow -- --ignored`: must pass. It takes about 3–4 min and includes the 7 tests already ignored.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --bin jackioh -- fuzz:: positions:: --skip duos_fuzz::`: expect about 30–40 s of tests. Before: 138 s on 4 threads.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --bin jackioh -- fuzz:: positions:: --skip duos_fuzz:: --ignored`: must pass.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --bin jackioh -- duos_fuzz:: selfplay::` and the same with `--ignored`. Before: 34 passed in 79 s single-threaded.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --test acceptance daily`
- `cargo jackioh spec check`
- `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai -p jackioh-tools --all-targets -- -D warnings`

Compile takes about 2.5 min for each of the two test targets on this box, and the groups compile in CI too. So "under about 2 minutes" is met by the tests' own run time, and the compile cost is outside what the builder can change. Say so in the PR body.

## Done when

- [ ] 8 AI tests and 14 tools tests carry the exact ignore line. The tools tests are 10 in `fuzz.rs`, 2 in `positions.rs`, 1 in `duos_fuzz.rs` and 1 in `selfplay.rs`. Nothing is deleted, and no stand-in is written.
- [ ] `ai_slow.rs`'s header, `crates/ai/README.md` and `crates/tools/fuzz-corpus/README.md` no longer say these run per pull request.
- [ ] Both groups' per-PR test time is under about 2 minutes without compile, and both `--ignored` runs pass.
- [ ] `acceptance daily`, `spec check`, fmt and clippy pass.
- [ ] The PR body gives the before and after times. Before, from the issue: 6.6–6.7 min for `ai slow`, 4.3–6.2 min for `tools fuzz` and 3.1–3.5 min for `tools duos, selfplay`. After is from the PR's own CI. It also says both groups still have fast tests, so they are not empty. A person may merge them (they compile the same crates), but `.github/ci/rust-test.toml` is not editable by the bot.

## Risks

- **Lost per-PR coverage** is deliberate, per the owner. Rulings whose proving tests move: R186, R390 (none moved), R977000, R1006001, R1006003, R1006006 and R180. `spec check` still passes because the tests keep their names and the `daily:` prefix. Don't rename any test: names are in `proven_in`.
- **Duplicate `#[ignore]` or a wrong placement** breaks the acceptance lint. Insert only under `#[test]`, once per test, and don't indent differently from the neighbouring attribute.
- **The daily run must really include these.** `super.yml` runs `cargo test --workspace --tests … -- --ignored`, which covers bin unit tests per the issue. If an `--ignored` run fails locally, report it rather than hiding it. A test that only fails when run alone is a pre-existing problem to report, not to patch around.
- **Times are noisy.** A test near 8 s may be slower on CI. The borderline ones (`two_one_step_…` 8.3 s, `b26_…vs_greedy…` 9.9 s, `…coverage…` 9.4 s) are marked, so CI margin is on the safe side.

## Open questions

None. The CI-time waiver is the owner's decision, so nothing here needs a person. Deleting or merging an emptied group means editing `.github/ci/rust-test.toml`, which only a person can do, and the PR body says so.
```
